# `Html`

[Back to stdlib index](../stdlib.md)

Ipe.Html — HTML element builders.

Every element builder (`div` / `nav` / `table` / `br` / …) is ordinary Ipê
over two retained native primitives: `node` (a container element) and
`voidNode` (a childless void element). Those two, plus `text` / `doctype` /
`titleNode` / `styleNode`, are the irreducible `Html`-value constructors,
reached through point-free `Kernel.kernel "Html_*"` aliases. The un-escaped raw
escape hatch lives in `Ipe.Html.Unsafe.unsafeRaw`, not here.

The serialiser (`render` / `toString` / `escapeHtml` / `escapeAttr` /
`attrToString`) and `renderStatic` stay native — they are the XSS barrier and
the render sink — and are re-exposed here through the same alias mechanism so
`Html.render` / `Html.escapeHtml` keep resolving from user code. Event
attributes live in `Ipe.Html.Events`, not here.

## `node`

```ipe
node : String -> List (Attribute msg) -> List (Html msg) -> Html msg
```

`node tag attrs children` — a container element `<tag …>children</tag>`.
A `script` or `style` tag renders only over trusted raw children (see
`Ipe.Html.Unsafe` and `styleNode`), and `plaintext` or an unsafe tag name
never renders: a refused element renders nothing.

## `voidNode`

```ipe
voidNode : String -> List (Attribute msg) -> Html msg
```

`voidNode tag attrs` — a childless void element `<tag …>` (self-closed by
the render sink for any void tag).

## `text`

```ipe
text : String -> Html msg
```

`text s` — an escaped text node. The value is escaped at the render sink,
so this is the safe-by-construction way to embed user content.

## `doctype`

```ipe
doctype : List (Html msg) -> Html msg
```

`doctype children` — wraps children in the document `<!DOCTYPE html>`
preamble emitted by the render sink.

## `titleNode`

```ipe
titleNode : String -> Html msg
```

`titleNode s` — `<title>` wrapping a raw string directly.

## `styleNode`

```ipe
styleNode : List (Attribute msg) -> String -> Html msg
```

`styleNode attrs css` — a `<style>` element whose CSS body is
neutralised once at construction so it can open or close no markup: every
`</style` is removed, and a space follows every `<` that comes before a
letter, `/`, `!` or `?`. CSS reads that space as whitespace, but inside a
CSS string or `url(...)` it is kept, so
`url("data:image/svg+xml,<svg ...>")` arrives as `< svg` and a string
holding `</style>` loses that run.

## `render`

```ipe
render : Html msg -> String
```

`render html` — serialise an `Html` tree to a `String`, escaping text and
attribute values at the sink.

## `renderStatic`

```ipe
renderStatic : (model -> Html msg) -> model -> Task Error ()
```

`renderStatic view model` — render a `model -> Html msg` view once to a
static HTML string, as a `Task`.

## `toString`

```ipe
toString : Html msg -> String
```

`toString html` — an alias of `render`.

## `escapeHtml`

```ipe
escapeHtml : String -> String
```

`escapeHtml s` — escape a string for safe inclusion in text content.

## `escapeAttr`

```ipe
escapeAttr : String -> String
```

`escapeAttr s` — escape a string for safe inclusion in an attribute value.

## `script`

```ipe
script : List (Attribute msg) -> List (Html msg) -> Html msg
```

`script attrs children` — a `<script>` element. It renders only over a
trusted body (`Ipe.Html.Unsafe.unsafeRaw`, or use `unsafeScript`); a text,
element or empty body is refused and renders nothing, so data never runs.
